overview.startPoint: Talk to one of the firemakers, for example Phoenix, gathered around a cave entrance south of Eagles' Peak and west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

options.text: Travelling firemaker? What does that involve?
This seems dangerous. Why put your lives at risk?

blocks.html: Enter the tunnel.
blocks.text: Enter the tunnel.
Room 1

blocks.html: Talk to Flint for a pitch can.
blocks.text: Talk to Flint for a pitch can.

blocks.html: Use the pitch can to light fires by right-clicking make-fire-here to complete the arrow on the ground. If you mess up, you can right-click the fire to stomp it out. You can also drag the pitch can onto an action bar, and use a key-bind to light fires with it. However, this will light a fire one tile in front of you.

blocks.html: The lights dim after a short time, dealing 50-100 damage every few seconds. Lighting the fires postpones this effect.

substeps.html: If you come close to dying in this room, you will be rescued by the firemakers and restored to full health. If this happens, any activated pillars will remain activated, but all lit fires will be extinguished. You don't have to relight all the fires.

blocks.html: Strategy to defeat Char
During the fight, you should keep a distance from Char at all times.
blocks.text: During the fight, you should keep a distance from Char at all times.

blocks.html: The amount of damage you deal is determined by the amount of flames you have lit (100 damage per active flame).
blocks.text: The amount of damage you deal is determined by the amount of flames you have lit (100 damage per active flame).

blocks.html: As you fight her, keep lighting flames.
blocks.text: As you fight her, keep lighting flames.

blocks.html: Add your pitch can to your ability bar to make fires much more easily.
blocks.text: Add your pitch can to your ability bar to make fires much more easily.

blocks.html: Run around the edges of the arena lighting flames as fast as you can.
blocks.text: Run around the edges of the arena lighting flames as fast as you can.

blocks.html: When you have 10 active flames, run some distance from Char and attack her a few times, dealing 1,000-5,000 damage in total.
blocks.text: When you have 10 active flames, run some distance from Char and attack her a few times, dealing 1,000-5,000 damage in total.

blocks.html: Repeat steps 1-2 until she is defeated.
blocks.text: Repeat steps 1-2 until she is defeated.

blocks.html: Remember to avoid the firewalls by maneuvering through the gaps, or you'll be hit for 1,000-4,000 damage.
blocks.text: Remember to avoid the firewalls by maneuvering through the gaps, or you'll be hit for 1,000-4,000 damage.

blocks.html: While Char is glowing she is invincible, so focus on lighting flames during this period.
blocks.text: While Char is glowing she is invincible, so focus on lighting flames during this period.

blocks.html: After the battle ends, talk to Char.
blocks.text: After the battle ends, talk to Char.
